select.isND:
@or(
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'ND'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'N.D.'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'N.D'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'NOT DETECTED'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'NON DETECTED'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], '불검출'),
  and(
    greaterOrEquals(
      length(item()?['ppmNorm']),
      2
    ),
    equals(
      replace(item()?['ppmNorm'], '-', ''),
      ''
    )
  )
)
select.isMissing:
@or(
  empty(item()?['ppmNorm']),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], '-'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'N/A'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'NA'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'NULL'),
  equals(item()?['ppmNorm'], 'NONE')
)
